categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and directly modifies the mempool fee estimator in src/policy/fees/.
categories.rationale: Fixes an edge-case miscalculation in fee estimator block coverage where witness differences between mined and mempool transactions distort the 75% health check threshold. The PR description notes that counting local weight can cause health checks to falsely pass or fail when a block confirms a lighter or heavier witness variant than the mempool entry, confirmed as an inherent false positive by reviewers.

categories.rationale: The change does not alter RPC behavior or interface contracts, but merely updates an existing fee estimator call inside the fees RPC handler.
